recommendation: 3:1 minimum for borders states and icons against adjacent colors
Author-styled focus indicator needs 3:1 against adjacent colors (1.4.11); AAA 2.4.13 also needs 3:1 between the same pixels focused vs unfocused
3:1 contrast between link color and surrounding text if not underlined
Pair red with icon and text label never color alone
Define semantic colors (success warning error info) with accessible variants
Test all pairings in both light and dark; focus and hover included
Use patterns shapes and labels in addition to color
Check brand hues at AA for text; add accessible variant if failing

WCAG 2.x contrast must hold against the rendered background behind the text across the whole area the text occupies including intermediate colors; checking gradient stops or a few eyedropper samples does not prove the worst case; if the worst case cannot be established the result is unverified (G18)
Create accessible tokens (default hover active focus disabled) all >= 3:1
Disabled controls need visual distinction but are exempt from contrast; never rely on low contrast alone for meaning
Support forced-colors media query; use CanvasText and system colors
Validate palette in deuteranopia protanopia tritanopia simulators
Ensure adjacent categorical colors differ in luminance not just hue
